strings.ui.cultivation.confucian_desc: The written word of an upright heart: glyph arts that follow your Insight, and Righteous Qi, +%d%% against Hollow and demonic foes.
strings.ui.cultivation.dao_top_tier: This Dao has reached its highest tier.
strings.ui.cultivation.debt_dou_rescue: Little Dou, carried through the Hollow Night
strings.ui.cultivation.foundation_hollow: Hollow: too much of this realm's Qi came from pills. Your next great breakthrough counts it as an unmet requirement. Settle foundation in seclusion.
strings.ui.cultivation.foundation_sound: Share of this great realm's Qi that came from pills, raw herbs and cores. Above the red line the foundation is hollow.
strings.ui.cultivation.golden_body_desc: Hold a vow to call the Golden Body. Each hundred merit calms the heart of a vow-keeper by 10.
strings.ui.cultivation.heart_calm: Your heart is quiet. Forced breakthroughs, a changed method, defeats and sin feed the demons.
strings.ui.cultivation.heart_demon_steps: Your next great breakthrough carries +%d risk from them, and they will stand beside your Reflection. Meditate, or burn Calm Incense.
strings.ui.cultivation.leave_blood_confirm: Leave the Blood path? The heart demon gains %d.
strings.ui.cultivation.leave_path_confirm: Leave the Confucian path? Turning from it marks the heart (+%d heart demon).
strings.ui.cultivation.merit_line: Merit %d · next calm at %d · vows held %d
strings.ui.cultivation.merit_not_ready: %d merit eases one great breakthrough in each realm.
strings.ui.cultivation.merit_ready: Your merit will ease a great breakthrough in this realm.
strings.ui.cultivation.no_dao_insight_yet_use: No Dao insight yet. Use techniques, meditate at insight stones and craft to begin comprehending.
strings.ui.cultivation.no_resistance: Your body has not learnt any pill yet.
strings.ui.cultivation.poison_body_desc: With a poison art known, toxicity past half your tolerance turns into poison on every foe you hit.
strings.ui.cultivation.poison_no_art: Learn a poison art first (Peddler Shao, at night).
strings.ui.cultivation.residue_harmless: %.1f  ·  not yet enough to slow you
strings.ui.cultivation.set_close_the_game_and: Set: %s. Close the game and your disciple cultivates.
strings.ui.cultivation.settle_foundation_desc: Makes pill-given Qi your own; burns off residue
strings.ui.cultivation.switch_method_you_lose_qp: Switch method? You lose %s QP and your foundation becomes Unstable for a while.
strings.ui.cultivation.vows_intro: A vow forbids one thing for as long as you hold it and gives a steady gift for it. Letting a vow go breaks it: +%d heart demon.
strings.ui.cultivation.you_know_no_cultivation_m: You know no cultivation method yet. Lu will teach you one.
strings.ui.cultivation.stored_banks: banks here once the bar is full
strings.ui.exchange.100_taels_buy_1_spirit: 100 taels buy 1 Spirit Stone, less a 20% fee. Stones sell for 100 taels less the fee.
strings.ui.exchange.rate_note: 100 taels buy a Spirit Stone, 10 stones a Sage Crystal and 100 crystals a Star Jade, less a 20% fee each way.
strings.ui.fates.intro: The breakthrough has shaken your fate loose. Keep one of the three: each gives something, and most take something back.
strings.ui.fates.none: No fate waits for you now. One is drawn after each great breakthrough.
strings.ui.fates.this_realm: Part of this lasts only until your next great realm.
strings.ui.fates.title: Breakthrough Fate
strings.ui.fishing.hold_to_reel_keep_the: Hold to reel · keep the line in the jade band
strings.ui.forge.awaken_need_crystal: Weapon Soul Crystal · %d in the bag
strings.ui.forge.awaken_skill: Awake, it strikes on its own: %s, every %d blows. It glows in your hand.
strings.ui.forge.awaken_skill_one: Awake, it strikes on its own: %s, every %d blow. It glows in your hand.
strings.ui.forge.awakened_line: Awakened: %s strikes on its own every %d blows.
strings.ui.forge.awakened_line_one: Awakened: %s strikes on its own every %d blow.
strings.ui.forge.cannot_salvage: Worn, bound and locked pieces are never salvaged.
strings.ui.forge.choose_both: Choose the piece to take from, then the piece to give to.
strings.ui.forge.enhance_help: Choose a piece on the left. Up to +5 an enhancement always takes. From there it can fail, but it never breaks the piece or takes a level: each failure adds 5% pity to the next try on that piece.
strings.ui.forge.failed: It did not take. Pity now +%d%%.
strings.ui.forge.inherit_help: Move a piece's enhancement, less two levels, onto a new piece for the same slot. The old piece goes back to +0.
strings.ui.forge.max: This piece is at +10, as far as the forge can take it.
strings.ui.forge.natal_broken: Broken: its power is dark until it is re-forged.
strings.ui.forge.natal_help: From Heart Tempering one weapon can be your Natal treasure. It grows with you: kills, techniques and ore fed at the forge raise it to level 10 (+2% stats a level), and its item level follows yours up to the grade band above its own. A boss's shatter blow, or drawing on it with too little Spirit, breaks it until it is re-forged.
strings.ui.forge.reroll_help: Choose a piece with affixes. Lock one affix to keep it (the reroll then costs double), roll the rest again, and choose the old roll or the new.
strings.ui.forge.salvage_help: Tap pieces to break them down into their metal and Refining Essence. Worn, bound and locked pieces are never salvaged.
strings.ui.garden.empty: Empty. Choose a seed at the right to plant.
strings.ui.garden.kind_note_steamed: Pills made from steamed herbs carry 30% less toxicity. A pill takes the prep of its principal herb.
strings.ui.garden.kind_note_wine: Pills made from wine-soaked herbs are 10% stronger. A pill takes the prep of its principal herb.
strings.ui.garden.need_water: Bottle water at a Qi spring.
strings.ui.garden.no_herbs: No plain herbs in your bag.
strings.ui.garden.no_rack: You need a drying rack. Mei Qing in Stoneford's Artisan Row gives one for Batch Work.
strings.ui.garden.no_seeds: No seeds in your bag. Granny Liu and the Greyreed trade post sell them.
strings.ui.garden.tap_a_bed: Tap a bed to tend it.
strings.ui.garden.title: Herb Garden
strings.ui.gift.given_today: They've had a gift from you today. Come back tomorrow.
strings.ui.gift.nothing: Nothing in your bag can be given away.
strings.ui.gift.pick_first: Pick something from your bag first.
strings.ui.gift.rules: One gift a day. What they love is worth a whole heart; what they like, a little less; anything else is a courtesy. Hearts open recipes, keepsakes, better prices and, for companions, bonds.
strings.ui.gift.title: A Gift
strings.ui.guild.commissions_locked: The board takes orders only from badge holders. Pass the Adept exam first.
strings.ui.guild.title: Alchemist Guild
strings.ui.guqin.calm: Your Qi settles: meditation +%d%% for 30 minutes.
strings.ui.guqin.how: Pluck each string as its note reaches the bridge: tap the string's peg, or press 1 to 5.
strings.ui.guqin.ready: A short piece, sixteen notes. The steadier your hand, the calmer the Qi.
strings.ui.guqin.title: The Guqin
strings.ui.herb.sense_spent: Picked. It grows back with its next ripening.
strings.ui.inventory.binding_hold_still: Binding… hold still, and do not be struck.
strings.ui.inventory.cape_slot_opens_at_heaven: Cape slot opens at Heaven Glimpse 1
strings.ui.inventory.halo_charge: Halo +%d%% · grows in a dense-Qi storage chest
strings.ui.inventory.hint_sell: to a trader: a %s fetches %d taels.
strings.ui.inventory.hint_sell_one: to a trader: a %s fetches %d tael.
strings.ui.inventory.hint_walk: it floats into the first empty space.
strings.ui.inventory.next_gourd: a %s holds %d: %d more spaces, a wider sky
strings.ui.inventory.next_gourd_one: a %s holds %d: %d more space, a wider sky
strings.ui.inventory.prep_steamed: Steamed: pills made from it carry 30% less toxicity.
strings.ui.inventory.prep_wine: Wine-soaked: pills made from it are 10% stronger.
strings.ui.inventory.sealed_bind_it_to_wake: Sealed: its power sleeps until you bind it.
strings.ui.inventory.soul_talisman_slot_opens_at: Soul Talisman slot opens at Spirit Awakening 1
strings.ui.inventory.spare_set: Set as your spare weapon. Swap with R or the Swap button.
strings.ui.inventory.spirit_refuses: Your Spirit is below its %d: it gives half and keeps its skill.
strings.ui.inventory.spirit_wakes_line: It wakes at affinity %d, and only at %s.
strings.ui.inventory.the_spirit_gourd_holds_your: The Spirit Gourd holds your bag
strings.ui.inventory.the_spirit_throws_you_off: The spirit throws you off. Your soul aches.
strings.ui.inventory.the_spirit_wakes_and_answer: The spirit wakes and answers you.
strings.ui.inventory.unappraised: Sealed. It could be genuine, or a dyed fake. Appraise it before you trust it.
strings.ui.inventory.vessel_ridden: You ride it when you fly.
strings.ui.map.caption: World map
strings.ui.map.no_objectives: No quest is tracked and no world event is coming here. Track a quest on the Quests page.
strings.ui.map.none_here: No %s are found in this land.
strings.ui.map.rank_enter: You enter the ranking at %s CP (yours: %s), or by reaching the Valley Tournament finals.
strings.ui.map.way_not_open: The way there is not open yet. The story will take you.
strings.ui.map.zone_locked: You have not set foot in the %s yet.
strings.ui.menu.save_and_return_to_character: Save and return to character selection?
strings.ui.mercy.line: They throw down their weapon and drop to one knee. “Enough! I yield! Do what you will.”
strings.ui.mercy.note: Some who are spared remember it. Some who are killed have kin.
strings.ui.mercy.title: Mercy
strings.ui.notice.all_of_today_missions_are: All of the board's missions are done. New ones at dawn; a day you miss is kept for you.
strings.ui.notice.missions_open_at_qi_kindling: Missions open at Qi Kindling 1 for sect disciples. Days you miss wait on the board, up to three.
strings.ui.pets.aptitude_hidden: growth and aptitude show at Juvenile
strings.ui.pets.construct_care: It fights beside you and takes a pet slot. It never eats, bonds, breeds, fuses or grows; pills and rest do not mend it.
strings.ui.pets.construct_line: A construct of wood and jadeiron: no bond, no hunger.
strings.ui.pets.construct_repair: Repair it at the Stoneford tinkerer's bench when it breaks.
strings.ui.pets.egg_blood_why: Given, or your blood is still recovering
strings.ui.pets.egg_element_why: No core of another egg's element
strings.ui.pets.fuse_help: Fuse another animal into %s: a 30%% chance at each of its traits and learned skills, and half its purity above this one's. The other animal is gone for good.
strings.ui.pets.no_spirit_animals_yet_hermit: No spirit animals yet. Hermit Yao in the Reed Marsh looks after orphaned young ones.
strings.ui.pets.swarm_bite: Bite: %d%% of your Qi attack a second, for 8 s
strings.ui.pets.swarm_help: The swarm eats an hour's food an hour and grows while fed, even while you are away; unfed, it dwindles. Open the Copperjaw Box from your bag in a fight.
strings.ui.pets.swarm_no_ore: You carry no ore the beetles will eat.
strings.ui.pets.swarm_queen: A Queen: they grow half again as fast and bite a quarter harder.
strings.ui.pets.post_opens: This post opens when you reach %s.
strings.ui.pets.wounded_short: Grievously wounded: −20% until it rests at the Beast Hall
strings.ui.pets.hungry: Hungry: it works at 70% until it is fed
strings.ui.pets.fed_today: Fed today: it works at its full strength
strings.ui.pets.breed_none: Breeding takes two Adults of one family.
strings.ui.pets.no_food: You carry none of its favourite foods, and no core of its element to devour.
strings.ui.pets.no_books: No skill book in your bag.
strings.ui.pets.tap_book: Tap a book to teach it
strings.ui.pets.tap_gear: Tap a piece to put it on
strings.ui.pets.no_gear: No pet gear in your bag.
strings.ui.pets.egg_where: Warm a Spirit Egg from your bag to hatch it here.
strings.ui.pets.opens_aptitude_trait: shows its growth, aptitude and first trait
strings.ui.posts.bench_more: More apprentices at 60 and 150 craft levels in all (you have %d); a bench point every 5.
strings.ui.posts.bench_note: Apprentices make components while you are away, up to %s of each. Collect them into the pouch.
strings.ui.posts.bench_short: Apprentices make components while you are away.
strings.ui.posts.board_hint: Soonest full first · tap a tablet to turn it
strings.ui.posts.first_basket: Keep Post at a node to put a basket here
strings.ui.posts.first_step1_sub: ore, herbs, a fishing spot or a swarm
strings.ui.posts.first_step2_sub: the basket fills while it burns or you are away
strings.ui.posts.first_step3_sub: the haul goes to the Storehouse
strings.ui.posts.first_sub: Everyone you are not playing keeps working.
strings.ui.posts.no_points_text: No points free: they come with craft levels.
strings.ui.posts.no_post: No post. Stand at a node and press Keep Post.
strings.ui.posts.node_info_none: Stand beside an ore vein, herb patch, fishing spot or insect swarm to see what a post there would yield: the jade Chance bar fills as your Finesse grows, then the gold Abundance bar counts extra units a success.
strings.ui.posts.roll_note: Everyone you are not playing keeps working at their post. Settle to send their hauls to the Storehouse.
strings.ui.posts.store_empty: Empty. Settle a post to fill it.
strings.ui.posts.store_note: The account's bulk store. Posts fill it; tap an item to take up to 50 into the bag (in a town).
strings.ui.posts.title: Roll-Call
strings.ui.posts.vigil_taken: Vigil kept. Choose who to play next.
strings.ui.posts.vows_note: A Post Vow sharpens a disciple kept at their post, at a price. Learned once for the account with Spirit Wisps; two held per disciple.
strings.ui.pouches.note: Tailor Xun folds more room into %s's pouch. Four compartments to a category; a post stops filling a category when it is full.
strings.ui.pouches.title: Qiankun Pouches
strings.ui.quest.abandon_this_quest_you_can: Abandon this quest? You can take it again later.
strings.ui.quest.gap_post: Your other characters' posts and a Vigil keep working while you play
strings.ui.quest.gap_side: %d side quests open to you now
strings.ui.quest.gap_side_one: %d side quest open to you now
strings.ui.relations.alignment_note: Choices lean you one way or the other. Some masters and shops care which; your next realm never does.
strings.ui.relations.bond_dao_companion_note: One companion, for life, from one who holds you at five hearts. They support your breakthroughs and share what they learn.
strings.ui.relations.bond_master_note: The elder who took you as a personal disciple. Before you leave the valley, they pass on an art they never wrote down.
strings.ui.relations.bond_sworn_note: Up to three companions at four hearts, sworn under one name. Each one beside you makes the others stronger.
strings.ui.relations.challenge_later: At %d Fame (Rising), young masters of good families will come to towns looking for you.
strings.ui.relations.challenge_line: “So you are the one the valley keeps talking about. I have heard enough talk. Cross hands with me, here, where everyone can see.”
strings.ui.relations.challenge_stakes: Win: +%d Fame. Lose: −%d Fame. Decline: −%d Fame.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_legendary: They will be telling stories about you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_noted: Townsfolk know your name and greet you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_renowned: Your name travels ahead of you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_rising: Young masters come looking to test you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_brings_unknown: No one has heard of you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_note: Tournaments, great foes and the Beast Tide raise your name. Losing a spar where a town can see costs you.
strings.ui.relations.fame_top: The highest a name can go
strings.ui.relations.fortune_note: Fortune encounters met: %d. At most one every three hours of play.
strings.ui.relations.grudges_note: Killing a faction's named people raises its grudge. Past its threshold it sends hunters after you. Blood money, a duel or a favour settles it.
strings.ui.relations.jealous_line: He saw the clouds gather over you and cannot bear it. "Heaven answered you? Show me why." A spar, at your new strength.
strings.ui.relations.merit_ready: Your merit will ease this great realm's next major breakthrough by one risk step.
strings.ui.relations.merit_short: %d more merit and the next major breakthrough is one risk step easier (every %d merit, once per great realm).
strings.ui.relations.merit_used: Merit has already eased a breakthrough in this great realm. It will again in the next.
strings.ui.relations.no_challenge: No one is waiting for you here. Young masters find you in towns, at most once a day.
strings.ui.relations.no_deeds: Nothing yet. Help someone, or cheat someone, and it will be written here.
strings.ui.relations.no_friends: No one yet. Help people, and bring them what they love.
strings.ui.relations.no_grudges: No faction wants you dead. Yet.
strings.ui.relations.sin_note: Sin feeds the heart demon and adds bolts to your heavenly tribulation.
strings.ui.relations.title: Relations
strings.ui.revival.early_grace: Until Bone Forging 5 a fall costs nothing: no progress, no injury. After that it costs 10% of a stage's progress.
strings.ui.revival.early_grace_short: No progress lost before Bone Forging 5.
strings.ui.revival.soul_escape: Your nascent soul fled to the shrine: you lose 5% of this stage's progress and may carry an injury.
strings.ui.revival.you_lose_10_of_this: You lose 10% of this stage's progress and may carry an injury.
strings.ui.revival.kept_gear: Your gear and all your bag holds

strings.ui.settings.keyboard_arrows_wasd_move_sp: Keyboard: arrows/WASD move · Space jump · J attack or talk · F interact · K guard (tap to dodge) · C cultivate · P the Cultivation page · Q quick-use · V draught · Z and X treasures · R swap weapons · G Presence · H Sphere · O keep post · 1–8 techniques · Tab menu · I or B bag · M map · L quests · E spirit animals.
strings.ui.settings.no_exports_yet: No exports on this device yet.
strings.ui.settings.classic_side_view_note: A fallback: new characters play the older side-view world. Characters already made keep their own view.
strings.ui.settings.world_extras_note: The top-down world's colour grade, hours of the day, cloud shadows and drifting particles. Turn off on older phones.
strings.ui.settings.replace_your_saves_with_this: Replace every save on this device with this export? Your current saves are kept as a backup (.bak).
strings.ui.settings.saves_are_written_every_few: Saves are written every few seconds and when the app is paused. A backup of each file is kept and used automatically if a save is damaged.
strings.ui.tutorial.go.open: Something new is open. Tap here.
strings.ui.tutorial.go.place: Go to %s. The gold mark on your map leads there.
strings.ui.settings.replay_tutorials_note: Every page shows its tour again. A page's ? shows its own.
strings.ui.settings.tutorials_replayed: Each page will show its tour again.
strings.ui.tutorial.menu.hint: The Menu is open to you. Tap it to see every page.
strings.ui.tutorial.menu.1: Every page of the game hangs here, one tablet each.
strings.ui.tutorial.menu.2: Your own things first: your record, Cultivation, Techniques and the Bag.
strings.ui.tutorial.menu.3: The world next: your quests, the map, the calendar and the Codex.
strings.ui.tutorial.menu.4: A dim tablet is still shut. Tap it to learn what opens it.
strings.ui.tutorial.menu.5: Close the Menu here, or tap anywhere outside it.
strings.ui.tutorial.bag.1: All you carry floats here. Tap a thing to read it and use it.
strings.ui.tutorial.bag.2: What you wear circles you. Tap a worn piece to compare it or take it off.
strings.ui.tutorial.bag.3: Show one kind at a time: gear, pills or materials.
strings.ui.tutorial.bag.5: Keys and quest things wait in the Key Pouch.
strings.ui.tutorial.gear.hint: You found something to wear. Open the Bag.
strings.ui.tutorial.gear.do: Tap your new piece, then Equip to wear it.
strings.ui.tutorial.quests.hint: Your quests are on the tracker. Tap it to open the Quests page.
strings.ui.tutorial.quests.1: The story's next step is pinned at the top.
strings.ui.tutorial.quests.2: Tap a slip to read it here: who asks, what to do and what it pays.
strings.ui.tutorial.quests.3: Go walks you there by itself.
strings.ui.tutorial.quests.4: Track keeps a quest on your screen. Up to three at once.
strings.ui.tutorial.quests.5: Quests you finish are kept here.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivate.1: Tap here to sit and meditate. Qi gathers while you sit still.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivate.2: This bar fills as you gather. When it is full, you climb a step.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivate.3: Your health and realm are on your panel. Tap it to see your record.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivation.hint: You can cultivate now. Open the Menu to see your path.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivation.1: The great realms, from Mortal up the mountain. Yours is lit.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivation.2: Each realm is a stair. You sit on the step you have reached.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivation.3: This step, the next, and what the gate at the top asks of you.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivation.4: Meditate to gather Qi and climb. It keeps going while you are away.
strings.ui.tutorial.cultivation.5: More tabs open as you grow. Tap a dim one to see what opens it.
strings.ui.tutorial.codex.hint: The Codex is open: a book of all you learn. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.codex.1: Each ribbon opens a part of the book.
strings.ui.tutorial.codex.2: Tap an entry to read what you have learned of the world.
strings.ui.tutorial.codex.3: Turn the page at its corner.
strings.ui.tutorial.codex.4: The Collection counts the beasts you defeat.
strings.ui.tutorial.codex.5: Achievements keep your deeds. Some give you titles.
strings.ui.tutorial.foundation.hint: You have Foundation points to spend. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.foundation.do: Tap +1 to put a point into a meridian.
strings.ui.tutorial.foundation.1: Each Level gives you points. Those not yet spent wait here.
strings.ui.tutorial.foundation.2: Each meridian makes one side of you stronger. The line beside it says how.
strings.ui.tutorial.foundation.3: A bar fills with your points. Its gates open at 25, 50 and 100.
strings.ui.tutorial.foundation.4: Changed your mind? Reset is free until Qi Unfurling.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.hint: You can learn techniques now. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.1: Each seal is an element's tree. Dim ones open at later Levels.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.2: Drag the tree to look around. Each card is an art or a step toward one.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.3: Jump straight to a weapon's family of arts here.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.4: Tap a card to read it here: what it does, what it needs, and Learn.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.5: Arts you know go in these slots. They are your buttons in a fight.
strings.ui.tutorial.techniques.6: Learned jumps from one art you know to the next.
strings.ui.tutorial.realisation.hint: You have a Realisation to spend on an art. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.realisation.do: Tap a lit card, then Learn to spend your Realisation.
strings.ui.tutorial.skills.1: Your techniques wait round Attack. Tap one to use it; hold it to aim.
strings.ui.tutorial.skills.2: Attack is always here. An art needs a moment before it comes back.
strings.ui.tutorial.map.hint: The map is yours now. Tap it to see where to go.
strings.ui.tutorial.map.1: Your land, painted. Open places glow; gold is where you stand.
strings.ui.tutorial.map.2: Tap a place to read about it on the card at the right.
strings.ui.tutorial.map.3: Walk takes you there along the roads.
strings.ui.tutorial.map.4: Show resources or your quests' goals on the map.
strings.ui.tutorial.map.5: Other lands, and the Heaven Ranking, are up here.
strings.ui.tutorial.calendar.1: The season now. Some herbs grow in one season only.
strings.ui.tutorial.calendar.2: This week, day by day. Gold slips are under way; violet ones are coming.
strings.ui.tutorial.calendar.3: Tap a slip to read what happens and where.
strings.ui.tutorial.calendar.4: Go there walks you to it.
strings.ui.tutorial.calendar.5: Today's weather, and what it changes.
strings.ui.tutorial.mail.hint: Letters can reach you now. Tap here to read your mail.
strings.ui.tutorial.mail.1: Your letters, newest on top. Red wax means you have not read it.
strings.ui.tutorial.mail.2: The letter you tapped lies open here.
strings.ui.tutorial.mail.3: Some letters carry things. Claim puts them in your Bag.
strings.ui.tutorial.mail.4: Claim all takes everything at once.
strings.ui.tutorial.character.hint: Your record is open. Tap your portrait to see it.
strings.ui.tutorial.character.1: This is you, as the world sees you.
strings.ui.tutorial.character.2: What you wear hangs either side. Tap a piece to change it in the Bag.
strings.ui.tutorial.character.3: Your realm, your health and Qi, and your numbers in a fight.
strings.ui.tutorial.character.4: Titles you earn hang here. Tap one to wear it.
strings.ui.tutorial.character.5: Aptitude, Attunement and Wardrobe are on the other tabs.
strings.ui.tutorial.sect.hint: You can join a sect. Open the Menu to see your sect.
strings.ui.tutorial.sect.1: Your sect's hall. Each row of seats is a rank, the master's at the top.
strings.ui.tutorial.sect.2: Your seat. Serve the sect to move up a row.
strings.ui.tutorial.sect.3: The next rank: what it asks, and its promotion trial.
strings.ui.tutorial.sect.4: Role shows your sect's teachings and the path you take in it.
strings.ui.tutorial.shop.hint: The shops are open to you. Find a merchant in town.
strings.ui.tutorial.shop.1: The wares on the shelves. Tap one to look at it.
strings.ui.tutorial.shop.2: The ware you chose and its price. Pick how many, then Buy.
strings.ui.tutorial.shop.3: Your bag is beside the stall. Tap a thing there to sell it.
strings.ui.tutorial.shop.4: Your money is here on the counter.
strings.ui.tutorial.notice_board.hint: The notice board has work for you. Find it in town.
strings.ui.tutorial.notice_board.1: Your sect's missions and the requests nearby are pinned here.
strings.ui.tutorial.notice_board.2: Bounties name wanted foes. Take up to two at a time.
strings.ui.tutorial.notice_board.3: Tap a paper to read it, then take the job.
strings.ui.tutorial.transfer_array.hint: The transfer arrays carry you across the sect. Step on one.
strings.ui.tutorial.transfer_array.1: This array's name, and the room it stands in.
strings.ui.tutorial.transfer_array.2: Each button is an array you know. Tap one to travel there.
strings.ui.tutorial.transfer_array.3: More arrays join the list as you find them.
strings.ui.tutorial.crafts.hint: You can craft now. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.crafts.1: Each tab is a craft. More open as you learn them.
strings.ui.tutorial.crafts.2: Your recipes. Tap one to see what it needs.
strings.ui.tutorial.crafts.4: What you have, and what the recipe makes.
strings.ui.tutorial.breakthrough.hint: You are at a bottleneck. Open the Menu to break through.
strings.ui.tutorial.breakthrough.1: The gate between your step and the next.
strings.ui.tutorial.breakthrough.2: What the gate asks. Gold is met; a dark one shows how to meet it.
strings.ui.tutorial.breakthrough.3: Your risk, and your chance to succeed.
strings.ui.tutorial.breakthrough.4: Offer pills in these dishes to lower the risk.
strings.ui.tutorial.breakthrough.5: Break through when you are ready.
strings.ui.tutorial.settings.1: Sound, controls, reading and your saves each have a tab.
strings.ui.tutorial.settings.2: Text size and gentler effects are under Accessibility.
strings.ui.tutorial.settings.4: Replay tutorials shows every page's tour again.
strings.ui.tutorial.emotes.1: Tap an emote to show it to everyone near you.
strings.ui.tutorial.emotes.2: Dim ones are earned; tap one to see how.
strings.ui.tutorial.guard.1: Tap here to dodge a blow. Hold it to guard.
strings.ui.tutorial.guard.2: Dodge, then strike back while the foe recovers.
strings.ui.tutorial.qi_pool.1: You have a Qi pool now. The blue bar on your panel is your Qi.
strings.ui.tutorial.qi_pool.2: Your arts spend Qi. Meditate or rest to fill it again.
strings.ui.tutorial.collection.hint: The Collection is open in the Codex. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.collection.1: Each beast you defeat is drawn here, its count beside it.
strings.ui.tutorial.collection.2: Turn the leaf for the next page.
strings.ui.tutorial.collection.3: Fill a page to earn its seals. Claim each for a gift that lasts.
strings.ui.tutorial.collection.4: Your deeds are kept under Achievements.
strings.ui.tutorial.achievements.1: Your deeds, done and to come. Some give titles.
strings.ui.tutorial.achievements.2: Turn the page at its corner.
strings.ui.tutorial.achievements.3: Paths Above lists the high ledges you have found.
strings.ui.tutorial.achievements.4: Seasons shows what each season brings.
strings.ui.tutorial.seasons.1: What each season brings: its herbs, its fish and its events.
strings.ui.tutorial.seasons.2: The rest of the book is under the other ribbons.
strings.ui.tutorial.storage.hint: Storage is open to you. Find a storage chest in town.
strings.ui.tutorial.storage.2: The chest keeps things for every one of your characters.
strings.ui.tutorial.storage.3: Tap a thing to move it across, in or out.
strings.ui.tutorial.characters.hint: You can play another character. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.characters.1: Each of your characters, painted in a row.
strings.ui.tutorial.characters.3: Give a task to do while you play someone else.
strings.ui.tutorial.characters.4: Switch to play the one you chose.
strings.ui.tutorial.posts.hint: Your characters can keep a post. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.posts.1: Each of your characters has a tablet: where they keep post and how it goes.
strings.ui.tutorial.posts.2: Tap a tablet to turn it over and see more.
strings.ui.tutorial.posts.3: Settle all brings every post's goods to the Storehouse.
strings.ui.tutorial.posts.4: Crafts, the Storehouse, the Bench and Vows each have a tab.
strings.ui.tutorial.bench.hint: You have Bench points to spend. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.bench.do: Tap a line to put a Bench point into it.
strings.ui.tutorial.bench.1: Bench points make your apprentice faster, fuller or wiser.
strings.ui.tutorial.bench.2: The next point comes with your craft levels.
strings.ui.tutorial.pouches.hint: Tailor Xun can sew your pouch deeper. Find the tailor.
strings.ui.tutorial.pouches.1: One pouch a kind of goods. Four pockets each.
strings.ui.tutorial.pouches.2: Sew makes a pouch one size bigger, so a post holds more.
strings.ui.tutorial.works.hint: The Works of the Post are open. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.works.1: Seven works stand in this cabinet. Each opens with its own lesson.
strings.ui.tutorial.works.3: The chosen work's choices are laid out here.
strings.ui.tutorial.works.4: What it does, and what it costs.
strings.ui.tutorial.post_art.hint: You have points for a Post Art. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.post_art.do: Tap an art to learn it with your points.
strings.ui.tutorial.post_art.1: Post Arts help your characters at their posts.
strings.ui.tutorial.post_art.3: Reset gives your points back to spend again.
strings.ui.tutorial.teleport.hint: Teleport stones are open to you. Find a stone.
strings.ui.tutorial.teleport.1: Every stone you have found is listed here.
strings.ui.tutorial.teleport.2: Tap one to travel there at once.
strings.ui.tutorial.teleport.3: Each trip costs a Spirit Stone shard.
strings.ui.tutorial.your_sect.hint: You can found your own sect. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.your_sect.1: The courtyard, the expeditions and your lands each have a tab.
strings.ui.tutorial.your_sect.2: Found the sect, then pick a building to raise.
strings.ui.tutorial.your_sect.3: Your grounds as they stand. Scaffolds wait to be built.
strings.ui.tutorial.your_sect.4: Send disciples on expeditions from here.
strings.ui.tutorial.spirit_animals.hint: Spirit animals can follow you now. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.spirit_animals.1: Your animals, each in its stall.
strings.ui.tutorial.spirit_animals.2: The chosen animal: its level, its bond and how it grows.
strings.ui.tutorial.spirit_animals.3: More tabs open as your animals grow.
strings.ui.tutorial.pet.1: Your animal's button. Tap to call it; hold for its orders.
strings.ui.tutorial.companions.hint: Fellow disciples can walk with you. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.companions.1: Each friend stands in a moon gate.
strings.ui.tutorial.companions.2: Tap one to walk beside you. Two may come at once.
strings.ui.tutorial.companions.3: Hearts grow on the red thread. Gifts and time together help.
strings.ui.tutorial.beast_arena.1: The pit. Your animals fight here.
strings.ui.tutorial.beast_arena.2: The ladder: ten tamers by rank. Beat the one above you.
strings.ui.tutorial.beast_arena.3: Fight alone with one animal, or with three.
strings.ui.tutorial.beast_arena.4: Five fights a day. Your rank pays out each week.
strings.ui.tutorial.core_exchange.1: Your beast cores, a shelf for each tier.
strings.ui.tutorial.core_exchange.2: Tap a core to sell it into the urn for Spirit Stones.
strings.ui.tutorial.core_exchange.3: The tally shows what you sold today.
strings.ui.tutorial.core_exchange.4: Rest your animals here to mend a grievous wound.
strings.ui.tutorial.relations.1: What the world remembers of you, in four tabs.
strings.ui.tutorial.relations.2: Merit on one side, sin on the other.
strings.ui.tutorial.relations.3: Bonds: your master, your sworn kin, your Dao Companion.
strings.ui.tutorial.relations.4: Fame: how far your name has gone, and what it opens.
strings.ui.tutorial.tower.1: The Trial Tower's floors. Climb them in order.
strings.ui.tutorial.tower.2: The chosen floor: its Level, its rule and its foes.
strings.ui.tutorial.tower.4: A floor you have cleared can be swept once a day for its loot.
strings.ui.tutorial.county.1: The county's favour, and what each tier gives.
strings.ui.tutorial.county.2: Today's jobs stand in the tube. Tap one to read it.
strings.ui.tutorial.county.3: The job you chose, hung to read.
strings.ui.tutorial.county.4: Relief: give silver for the poor, for merit and favour.
strings.ui.tutorial.guqin.1: Notes glide along the strings toward the bridge.
strings.ui.tutorial.guqin.2: Pluck each string as its note reaches the bridge.
strings.ui.tutorial.guqin.3: Steady playing speeds your meditation for a while.
strings.ui.tutorial.chess.2: Choose the point you think is right.
strings.ui.tutorial.chess.3: A right answer gives insight. Either way, the next comes tomorrow.
strings.ui.tutorial.exchange.hint: The money changer is open. Find the exchange in town.
strings.ui.tutorial.exchange.2: Tap a trade to change one money for another.
strings.ui.tutorial.auction.2: What it stands at, who holds it, and when it closes.
strings.ui.tutorial.auction.4: Every lot of the day. Tap one to bring it up.
strings.ui.tutorial.garden.hint: You can grow herbs now. Find a garden bed.
strings.ui.tutorial.garden.1: Your beds, terrace by terrace. Herbs grow even while you are away.
strings.ui.tutorial.garden.2: Water, Spirit Soil and dew wait in the basket.
strings.ui.tutorial.garden.3: Tend the chosen bed here: plant, water, harvest.
strings.ui.tutorial.garden.4: The racks dry what you pick.
strings.ui.tutorial.fishing.1: Wait for the bite, then tap at once to strike.
strings.ui.tutorial.fishing.2: Then hold to reel: keep the line in the band until the fish tires.
strings.ui.tutorial.fishing.3: Again casts once more. Done puts the rod away.
strings.ui.tutorial.fishing.hint: You can fish now. Find a fishing spot by the water.
strings.ui.tutorial.seclusion.hint: Seclusion is open. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.seclusion.1: Choose what to work on while you are away.
strings.ui.tutorial.seclusion.2: Seclusion keeps going when you close the game.
strings.ui.tutorial.seclusion.3: The other tabs of your cultivation are up here.
strings.ui.tutorial.body.hint: Body training is open. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.body.1: Your body's level. Training fills it.
strings.ui.tutorial.body.2: The rungs of the body: each asks a level, a trial and a bath.
strings.ui.tutorial.body.3: How to train is written here.
strings.ui.tutorial.heart.1: What your past costs you: heart demons, karma and old debts.
strings.ui.tutorial.heart.2: Relations shows what the world remembers of you.
strings.ui.tutorial.heart.3: The other tabs of your cultivation are up here.
strings.ui.tutorial.dao.hint: The Dao has opened to you. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.dao.1: Each Dao you walk, and how far you have come on it.
strings.ui.tutorial.dao.2: Contemplate a Dao to gain insight in it.
strings.ui.tutorial.dao.3: The other tabs of your cultivation are up here.
strings.ui.tutorial.vows.hint: Vows are open to you. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.vows.1: The paths you may walk, each on its card.
strings.ui.tutorial.vows.2: A vow forbids one thing and gives a steady gift. Breaking it costs.
strings.ui.tutorial.vows.3: The other tabs of your cultivation are up here.
strings.ui.tutorial.methods.1: Your cultivation methods. Each gathers Qi its own way.
strings.ui.tutorial.methods.3: The other tabs of your cultivation are up here.
strings.ui.tutorial.cooking.hint: You can cook now. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.cooking.1: Your recipes. Tap one to see what it needs.
strings.ui.tutorial.cooking.3: What you have, and what the dish does.
strings.ui.tutorial.alchemy.hint: Alchemy is open. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.alchemy.1: Your pill recipes. Tap one to see what it needs.
strings.ui.tutorial.alchemy.2: The furnace: put in the herbs and refine them, screen by screen.
strings.ui.tutorial.alchemy.3: What you have, and what the pill does.
strings.ui.tutorial.smithing.hint: The forge is open. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.smithing.1: Forge new gear, enhance it, pass on its gains or break it down.
strings.ui.tutorial.smithing.2: Your forge recipes. Tap one to see what it needs.
strings.ui.tutorial.smithing.3: Strike three times as the glow crosses the band.
strings.ui.tutorial.smithing.4: What you have, and what the piece does.
strings.ui.tutorial.talisman.hint: You can write talismans. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.talisman.2: Trace the stroke here in one go.
strings.ui.tutorial.talisman.3: What you have, and what the talisman does.
strings.ui.tutorial.guild.hint: A guild will test you. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.guild.2: Its rank exam: make so many, well enough, before the candle burns out.
strings.ui.tutorial.workshop.hint: The Workshop is open. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.workshop.1: Each tool on the wall is a craft. Tap one to take it down.
strings.ui.tutorial.workshop.2: The work lies on the bench.
strings.ui.tutorial.formations.hint: You can set formations. Open the Menu.
strings.ui.tutorial.formations.1: Place a formation where you stand. It helps while you stay.
strings.ui.tutorial.formations.2: Its plan and what it needs lie on the bench.
strings.ui.tutorial.formations.3: The other crafts hang on the wall.
